description: Subsurface Characterization of Selected Liquefaction Case Histories - 2023 Kahramanmaras Earthquake Sequence is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Jorge Macedo, Georgia Institute of Technology (gatech.edu). This dataset comprises a subsurface characterization of key liquefaction areas in Türkiye following the February 6, 2023, Kahramanmaraş earthquake sequence. Two Field testing campaigns were conducted in 2023 and 2024. Coverage: Türkiye. DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: Kahramanmaras Earthquake Sequence , Cone Penetration Testing, liquefaction,  Iskenderun, settlement, Golbasi. Published 2025-01-31. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
